messages:
alice_cs: Heads-up — prepping QBR for Meridian (renewal ~45d). Need slide owners, 2 exec asks, and a short risk heatmap. TL;DR: onboarding velocity has slowed and there are a couple of feature gaps customers keep surfacing.

miguel_csm: I can own the adoption + retention slides (slide 4 + backup). Will need DAU/MAU by cohort and churn drivers.

priya_ops: I’ll build the risk heatmap and runbook snippet. Also own migration timeline slide. When's the dry run?

alice_cs: Proposing dry run Tue 10am PT next week — does that work? Also here's the quick deck skeleton: https://redwood.app/meridian-qbr-draft (permissions open).

ev an_sales: I can draft the exec asks (cost-savings + roadmap commitment). Suggest one ask be a 90-day pilot for dedicated capacity.

sara_eng: I’ll add the infra/latency note and any outstanding buglets. Can someone pull recent perf deltas? @oncall_bot any chance of attaching latency trends for last 30d?

oncall_bot: Attached: /graphs/meridian-latency-30d.png — 95th p50/p95 included.

miguel_csm: Quick data note: activation curve drops most sharply after week 3 (new cohort). Could be onboarding doc gap or missing integrations.

priya_ops: Mitigation idea: run a cohort enablement webinar + an in-app checklist A/B for two weeks before the QBR. I can create the checklist content and run the cohort.

alice_cs: Action list (please copy into your notes):
```
- alice_cs: send dry run invite + draft deck by EOD today
- miguel_csm: final adoption slides (DAU/MAU + 3 churn levers) due Thu 5pm PT
- priya_ops: risk heatmap + runbook + enablement plan due Thu 5pm PT
- sara_eng: performance slide + attach logs/graphs due Fri 12pm PT
- evan_sales: exec asks + customer quote due Fri 5pm PT
```

ev an_sales: I’ll also pull one customer quote for the cost-savings ask. @miguel_csm can you flag 2 execs we want in the meeting?

miguel_csm: Flagging: Laura Chen (CTO) and Mateo Ruiz (Head of Product). Both expect succinct asks + clear success metrics.

alice_cs: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers on data permissions, ping me. Please drop final slides in the deck link by Fri 5pm PT. I’ll do a quick pass Sat morning and circulate the dry run invite. :raised_hands:

priya_ops: Noted — will include measurable success targets for each ask (activation %, time-to-first-success).

sara_eng: Will add a 2-slide appendix with mitigations and an ETA for bug fixes.

miguel_csm: One more — capture top 3 customer feedback bullets for the readout. I’ll compile from support tickets and CSM notes and post by Wed.

alice_cs: Excellent — thanks team. Will follow up with calendar invites + feedback capture template.
